```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("scripts").resolve()))
from data_loader import REPO_ROOT, load_json

stats = load_json(REPO_ROOT / "evals" / "reports" / "stats.json")
summary = pd.DataFrame(stats["summary"])
paired = pd.DataFrame(stats["paired_tests"])
```

## Mean judge scores

Scores are on a 1–5 Likert scale from Prometheus 2. Higher is better for all metrics.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
metric_order = [
    "capability",
    "jailbreak_robustness",
    "consistency",
    "transparency_candor",
    "transparency_invariance",
]
metric_labels = {
    "capability": "Capability",
    "jailbreak_robustness": "Jailbreak",
    "consistency": "Consistency",
    "transparency_candor": "Transparency (candor)",
    "transparency_invariance": "Transparency (invariance)",
}

pivot = (
    summary.groupby(["condition", "analysis_metric"], as_index=False)["mean"]
    .first()
    .pivot(index="analysis_metric", columns="condition", values="mean")
    .reindex(metric_order)
    .rename(columns={"A": "A (Base)", "B": "B (Inoculation)", "C": "C (Persona)"})
    .rename(index=metric_labels)
    .round(2)
)
pivot
```

## Significant pairwise differences

Paired *t*-tests on matched prompts (α = 0.05). Only consistency showed reliable differences involving Persona (C).

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
show = paired[
    paired["test_type"].eq("paired_ttest")
    & paired["significant"]
][
    [
        "condition_a",
        "condition_b",
        "analysis_metric",
        "mean_a",
        "mean_b",
        "mean_diff_a_minus_b",
        "p_value",
    ]
].copy()

show["comparison"] = show["condition_a"] + " vs " + show["condition_b"]
show["metric"] = show["analysis_metric"].map(metric_labels)
show = show.rename(
    columns={
        "mean_a": "Mean A",
        "mean_b": "Mean B",
        "mean_diff_a_minus_b": "Diff (A−B)",
        "p_value": "p-value",
    }
)[["comparison", "metric", "Mean A", "Mean B", "Diff (A−B)", "p-value"]]
show["p-value"] = show["p-value"].map(lambda p: f"{p:.4f}")
show
```

## All paired comparisons

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
# Full paired comparison table
full = paired[paired["test_type"].eq("paired_ttest")][
    [
        "condition_a",
        "condition_b",
        "analysis_metric",
        "mean_a",
        "mean_b",
        "p_value",
        "significant",
    ]
].copy()
full["comparison"] = full["condition_a"] + " vs " + full["condition_b"]
full["metric"] = full["analysis_metric"].map(metric_labels)
full["significant"] = full["significant"].map(
    lambda x: "**yes**" if x else "no"
)
full = full.rename(
    columns={
        "mean_a": "Mean A",
        "mean_b": "Mean B",
        "p_value": "p-value",
        "significant": "Significant",
    }
)[["comparison", "metric", "Mean A", "Mean B", "p-value", "Significant"]]
full["p-value"] = full["p-value"].map(lambda p: f"{p:.4f}")
full
```

## Interpretation

- **Capability:** No measurable drop from persona training (all conditions ≈ 3.28).
- **Jailbreak:** All conditions scored high (~4.3–4.4); little headroom for gains.
- **Consistency:** Persona (C) scored lowest (4.22 vs 4.78 Base, 4.58 Inoculation); both comparisons significant.
- **Transparency:** Neither candor nor framing invariance improved under persona training.
